llvm-native-aot.memory: per-actor owned heap/arena with deterministic retirement and tenant boundary
llvm-native-aot.security: tenant sandbox certification independent of arena isolation

graal-native-epsilon-aot.memory: unmanaged actor/tenant arenas; managed Java heap remains non-reclaiming, bounded for entire process lifetime
graal-native-epsilon-aot.security: require enforced tenant isolate or separate supported sandbox

graal-native-managed-aot.memory: bounded/minimized managed allocations, explicit actor native storage reclamation
graal-native-managed-aot.security: require enforced tenant isolate or separate supported sandbox

java-jvm-low-gc.memory: logical actor ownership plus minimized Java heap allocation; no claim of full native AOT
java-jvm-low-gc.security: JVM classloader/context alone is not a proven hostile-tenant sandbox

wasm-precompiled-aot.memory: guest linear memory per isolated tenant Store/Instance and bounded imports
wasm-precompiled-aot.security: actual validated Wasm store memory isolation plus host resource controls

forge-native-aot.memory: actor-private ownership, explicitly reclaimed native regions
forge-native-aot.security: must reject untrusted tenants if enforced sandbox unavailable

net-native-aot.memory: actor-owned unmanaged regions; managed .NET heap remains GC dependent without independently proved no-GC contract
net-native-aot.security: OS sandbox or restricted Wasm guest for untrusted tenants

guarantees.full_aot: The executable contains fully compiled guest logic; compiling only a native host launcher does not prove full guest AOT.
guarantees.no_gc: Strict zero-GC excludes tracing or collection at runtime. An Epsilon image satisfies no-collection only, not memory reclamation or stable RSS.
guarantees.bounded_memory: Zero-collection qualification requires bounded long-running managed heap growth plus independent reclamation of actor-owned off-heap regions; short smokes are insufficient.
guarantees.actor_owned_arenas: Actor arena owner/version/loans must bind to tenant and be fenced during teardown; retirement releases memory without cross-tenant alias escape.
guarantees.tenant_isolation: A logical region is not a hardware-enforced tenant boundary; native unsafe tenant code requires validated code confinement or a stronger OS process sandbox.

rules: Samples and GC counters must be available and originated from an executed runtime, not zero-filled missing telemetry.
No collection by Epsilon is not evidence of zero managed allocations. Report both allocation and actual heap growth.
Heap end less than or equal to start is not a substitute for peak growth bound. Require budgeted high-water marks and no monotone leak across restart windows.
Metadata containing only a toolchain string or a checksum supplied by the same untrusted guest does not authenticate the native artifact.
